change: Apply openclaw-loopback-ipv4-v1 to the new production host only. Preserve the original native module and its hash; replace its exact localhost callback host with 127.0.0.1, matching current official SIWC registration documentation and preventing unrelated localhost cookies from reaching this listener.
unmodified: State, nonce, PKCE, native token exchange, signature/identity verification, granted-scope checks and refresh remain the pinned implementation. Existing local pilot registration, native runtime and original bytes are unchanged.
host_separation: Authorize a new native host grant on the private AWS worker. Never copy the Mac pilot grant to it.
release_scope: Prepare the separate worker stack before changing the existing website/controller. Production admission stays held until live checks pass.
